training.old_cache_reuse: only pre-canonical source bank with geometry and explicit one-time adapter; never reinterpret old canonical tokens
training.labels: 4352-row soft-v2 overlay: 75 explicit bilateral P/N cells preserved, 69 U/unmentioned cells receive deterministic Core5-analogue soft labels at confidence 0.25, 24 S06 cells remain masked

bilateral_soft_label_policy.interpretation: weak-label imputation; no clinical truth or AUC claim

training.gold_policy: unchanged by orientation default; excluded unless explicitly authorized as training

inference.source: DICOM and images only; no training-case lookup or pathology scores
inference.orientation_model_precision: same published runtime: FP16 on T4, BF16 only supported SM>=8

compatibility: Frozen or already-running old experiments keep exact identity. New controlled legacy ablation needs an explicit legacy identity. New families retain their crop/size/training recipe and adapt only orientation using this standard.

evidence.score_sort_order: user reports v8 > unknown-side L/R mean > old; not independently quantifiable
